# Study International

> > The world's leading resource for international students seeking guidance on studying abroad across all education levels, from pre-K-12 through PhD programs.

Study International provides comprehensive directories of universities, schools, and courses alongside practical preparation guides, student advice, and inspiring stories from scholars and professionals worldwide. The platform covers major study destinations including the UK, USA, Canada, and Australia, while featuring diverse perspectives from international students across Asia, Europe, and beyond.

## Core Directories

- [Universities](https://studyinternational.com/universities): Global university directory for study abroad planning
- [Countries](https://studyinternational.com/countries): Study destination guides for UK, USA, Canada, Australia
- [Schools](https://studyinternational.com/schools): International schools directory with featured global institutions
- [Courses](https://studyinternational.com/courses): Course directory with subject browsing and degree programs

## Study Preparation & Guidance

- [Prepare](https://studyinternational.com/prepare): Study abroad preparation guide: visas, applications, costs
- [Advice](https://studyinternational.com/advice): Student advice, career guidance, and university experience tips
- [Online Learning](https://studyinternational.com/online): Online degrees, virtual learning, and distance education resources
